# P3 tournament tables (generated by p3t_report.py)

Lobbies: 300; ordered pairs played: 566.

## Head-to-head (row system's side, both seatings)

J = player-aware judge (model-judged, primary). CONS = population consensus (model-judged). Personal part = judge's personal-sum difference (pp of team skill sum). Record = judge-free realized record per assigned player (pp). Future hero WR = judge-free. 95% CIs (lobby bootstrap, widened for seed effects).

J corrected = attenuation-corrected J (personal part divided by lambda = 0.392; a model-based sensitivity).

J_cal = J with the two parts calibrated on held-out judge-window games (1.175 logit p_cons + 1.003 personal term, fitted this pass; a sensitivity check). J (outcome-free) = the same judge with players on heroes by their earlier games instead of the best of 120 assignments. Paired record = the judge-free record on players covered under both arms (coverage: share of players covered under both).
